text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon gave it everything she had in 
the Japan Dirt Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dirt races are a battle of stamina. Though 
she has to whip her exhausted body into 
shape for the Winning Live afterward, she 
says she loves giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My beloved dirt races and Winning Lives. I 
want just as many spectators to come watch 
them as they do turf GⅠs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a stepping stone toward that goal, she 
set her sights on the JBC Classic, where 
she could test her mettle against 
Senior-class Umamusume.
